sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: One row, one figure: 57 — how many of Contoso's physical shops have never closed, counted one per shop over the premises on record that carry no closing date and a blank status. What the 57 does NOT include: the 16 physical premises that did close (9 marked 'Closed', 7 'Restructured'), and the online store, which is a single sentinel row with no site, no country and no floor area and would make the figure 58 if counted as a shop. There is nothing else to exclude — dim_store holds only shops plus that one web row, no warehouses, departments or pop-ups. No period restriction was applied and none is possible: dim_store is a current snapshot, so this is the state as the dimension records it rather than as of any chosen date. Counting sites rather than premises gives the same 57, because every surviving shop stands on its own site.
